videos.title: Wintergreen Sessions Episode 1: Whatnot
videos.description:
Welcome to Wintergreen Sessions! This is a new series dedicated to capturing the live performances of artists and bands. I say we because we're working in conjunction with Kicker Pictures to record high quality professional video alongside the live audio recording. Today, we're starting off our series with a local band from here in CT. Whatnot recorded their debut record, "Self-Titled," here at the Wintergreen Studio. Today they start off their performance with a brand new, never before heard song. After that, they dive into two familiar tunes off their EP - With some slight changes.

Whatnot -

Instagram: @whatnot.band
